title: pvPerlinNoise
body:
## pvPerlinNoise

Adds a point array (default name PerlinNoise) of deterministic Perlin noise evaluated at each point's coordinates, varying between -|Amplitude| and |Amplitude|; geometry is unchanged. Use it to generate smooth pseudo-random test fields, perturb geometry together with a warp, or add texture for rendering. The same coordinates and settings always give the same values.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Frequency is per unit length of the dataset coordinates; on a domain spanning thousands of units the default 1 gives very fine noise, so scale it to your geometry.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `PerlinNoise`. Identity: `filters/PerlinNoise`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

| Port | Meaning / native port | Required | Multiplicity | Kind | Contract |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Input` | Required data input for the native Input port. Give the name of the upstream node to connect, or a {node, port} object to use another of its output ports. Accepted data: any dataset (meshes, grids, point sets) (vtkDataSet). | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":null,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkDataSet"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |

### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ComputeGradients` | The gradient is not implemented for Perlin noise. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `ImplicitFunction` | The noise function sampled at every point. Its only type is "Perlin Noise", with options Frequency (per-axis spatial frequency, higher is finer), Phase (per-axis shift; about one unit repeats the pattern) and Amplitude (output range ±\|Amplitude\|). | `{"type":"typed proxy","choices":["Perlin Noise"]}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `{"type":"Perlin Noise"}` |
| `ScalarArrayName` | Sets the name of the output noise array. | `{"type":"string"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `"REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"` |

### Nested `ImplicitFunction` → `Perlin Noise`

Syntax: `{"type":"Perlin Noise","options":{...}}`. Native identity: `implicit_functions/PerlinNoise`. Omitted nested options retain native values on subsequent visits.

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ImplicitFunction.options.Amplitude` | Scale of the output values: the noise varies between −\|Amplitude\| and \|Amplitude\|. A negative value inverts the pattern. | `{"type":"number"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `1` |
| `ImplicitFunction.options.Frequency` | Per-axis frequency [fx, fy, fz]: point coordinates are multiplied by these factors before the noise is evaluated, so larger values give finer, faster-varying noise and smaller values broader features; unequal values stretch the pattern along some axes. | `{"items":{"type":"number"},"maxItems":3,"minItems":3,"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `[1,1,1]` |
| `ImplicitFunction.options.Phase` | Shift [px, py, pz] of the noise pattern in noise space (VTK evaluates the noise at coordinate × Frequency − 2 × Phase). The pattern repeats roughly every unit of phase, so 0.5 is about a half-cycle shift; use it to decorrelate several noise layers or move the pattern without changing its scale. | `{"items":{"type":"number"},"maxItems":3,"minItems":3,"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `[1,1,1]` |

    "Input": "UPSTREAM_Input"
